bullets.title: LEAD - THE ARTIFACT-(a) ACCOUNT DOES NOT CLOSE AT TWO VENDORS. WSO2 SHIPPED AGENT MANAGER TO GENERAL AVAILABILITY UNDER APACHE 2.0 - AN OPEN CONTROL PLANE GOVERNING AGENTS ACROSS ANY FRAMEWORK, MODEL OR DEPLOYMENT, WITH PER-AGENT AND PER-ENVIRONMENT IDENTITY, MCP-LEVEL GOVERNANCE, A SANDBOXED RUNTIME AND FULL-STACK OBSERVABILITY - AND UNLIKE GOOGLE'S PRIVATE PREVIEW AND ANTHROPIC'S INTERNAL PLATFORM, WE CAN SELF-HOST IT THIS WEEK
bullets.summary: Dateline read at the page: GlobeNewswire 15 Sep 2026, trade syndication 16 Sep (Arabian Reseller, Channel Post MEA, CIO&Leader). Archive grep, honest: WSO2 appears ONCE across eighty-one files, in 2026-09-17.md, and only as a back-reference to "WSO2's registry schema" inside a standing-list line - no bullet, no dateline, no detail; Agent Manager ZERO, agent sprawl ZERO, sovereign AI governance ZERO, Forrester Agent Control Plane Landscape ZERO. Partially covered as a name, entirely uncovered as a thing. Beta June 2026; GA adds per-agent AND per-environment identity controls, MCP-level governance, and a sandboxed runtime. Scope as stated: control what agents access (LLM-, MCP- and agent-level guardrails, agent identity) and how they run (sandboxed runtime, observability, evaluation), across any framework, model or deployment, self-hosted or managed SaaS, Apache 2.0. Named in Forrester's Agent Control Plane Landscape Q2 2026; won Best Innovation in Open Source AI at the AI Dev Summit 2026 AI Tech Awards.
bullets.how: YES - the fire's whole point. In 48 hours three vendors published artifact (a) and we now hold all three layers: Google the OUTPUT SHAPE (severity, probability, plain-language rationale, recommended fix, API-pullable), Anthropic the METRIC DEFINITIONS (coverage, review latency, escalation rate) plus its own numbers, WSO2 the RUNNABLE IMPLEMENTATION - the only one that is neither private preview nor an internal platform. The honest row written at 10:00 (coverage ~0%, review latency = whenever Bobby notices, escalation rate undefined) now has a remedy costing a docker compose rather than a vendor relationship. The per-environment half of its identity model is what our estate most obviously lacks: Hermes, the worker queue and Cowork sessions all execute with the same deploy key against the same live sites, so "which environment did that action come from" is unanswerable today. NEW standing item (o): stand up Agent Manager self-hosted against ONE surface - the Hermes worker queue - and see whether coverage moves off zero in an afternoon.

bullets.title: SALESFORCE SHIPPED AIforce: A HEADLESS, COMPOSABLE LAYER EXPOSING A SYSTEM OF RECORD'S DATA, WORKFLOWS, BUSINESS LOGIC AND GOVERNANCE TO EXTERNAL AI INTERFACES - CLAUDE NAMED EXPLICITLY - SO AGENTS ACT UNDER THE RECORD SYSTEM'S OWN PERMISSIONS INSTEAD OF RE-IMPLEMENTING THEM
bullets.summary: Dateline read at the page: published 16 Sep 2026. Archive grep: AIforce ZERO, Agentforce Coworker ZERO, Live Nation ZERO across eighty-one files. Agents read, reason and act on Salesforce data wherever work happens, without copying data into third-party tools and without rebuilding business rules inside each agent. Shipped alongside Agentforce Coworker (Adecco deploying across 40 countries) and, on 17 Sep, a Live Nation production case study: festival and venue agents handling tens of thousands of fan interactions with ~85% resolved inside three responses, live in under 30 days.
bullets.how: MAYBE - we do not run Salesforce, so the product is not the item; the pattern is. AIforce answers a question PRAGMA's operator wedge keeps hitting: when a client's rules live in a system of record, does the agent re-implement them (fast, wrong, unauditable) or call them (slower, correct, auditable)? Salesforce just made "call them" the default for the largest CRM installed base, setting the expectation every smaller operator gets measured against. Directly relevant to how ATLAS reads the Lennar sheet and how B9 answer-page automation touches GSC/GA - both currently re-implement rather than call. The Live Nation numbers are also the cleanest public benchmark for the "headless domain agent, live in 30 days" claim PRAGMA makes in its own voice.

bullets.title: DIPP AI PUBLISHED A DATA CONTROL GATEWAY - A RUNTIME GATEWAY THAT REDACTS, REGION-PINS AND CHECKS EVERY PAYLOAD AGAINST TRAINING-EXCLUSION AND BOUNDARY POLICY ON EVERY CALL, AND REFUSES ROUTES THAT WOULD VIOLATE THEM - WHICH IS ITEM (j) BUILT BY SOMEONE ELSE: A GATE WITH ENFORCEMENT POWER AT THE CALL BOUNDARY
bullets.summary: Dateline read at the page: published 16 Sep 2026. Archive grep: Dipp ZERO, Data Control Gateway ZERO, training-exclusion ZERO, region-pin ZERO across eighty-one files. The stated pitch is the interesting part: buyers worried about data reaching third-party model training get an ARCHITECTURAL CONTROL rather than a contract clause, with enforcement logs as evidence, and the recommended evaluation is adversarial - attempt to exfiltrate sensitive fields and confirm the redaction rules hold.
bullets.how: MAYBE - not a purchase, a shape. Every gate we own emits a verdict and nothing consumes it; this one REFUSES THE CALL, which is the difference item (j) has been asking for since it was opened. Read against the 10:00 lead and arXiv:2609.20211 the three line up exactly: a gate that emits a pass is emitting a claim, a claim travels while its provenance does not, and the only reliable fix is enforcement IN the path rather than downstream of a summary. The adversarial-exfiltration test is one we have never run on our own credentialed paths, and we already have two credential classes flagged under item (k) and still not grepped.

bullets.how: YES - and the compaction fix is the one to carry. "Replies possibly not appearing after sending a message during session compaction" is the same failure class as 2.1.275's /rewind zero-filled file and the same class reconcile-before-building exists to survive: WORK HAPPENS, THE RECORD OF IT DOES NOT, and nothing errors. That skill's standing re-test - run it across an explicit compaction boundary, sharpened this morning by arXiv:2609.01836 to check whether compaction drops the PERMISSION and not merely the RECORD - now has a third documented instance in four days and should stop being a standing item and start being a Tuesday.

praxis_lesson: THIS MORNING THE REPORT WROTE "THE ACCOUNT ON ARTIFACT (a) CLOSES" AFTER TWO VENDORS, AND A THIRD HAD ALREADY BEEN GENERALLY AVAILABLE UNDER APACHE 2.0 FOR THREE DAYS. Google's is a private preview, Anthropic's is an internal platform described in a research post - both are designs we can read and neither is a thing we can run. WSO2's is git clone-able, self-hostable, and carries the one control our estate most conspicuously lacks: PER-ENVIRONMENT identity, so an action can be attributed not just to an agent but to the surface it fired from. Hermes, the worker queue and Cowork sessions all execute with the same key against the same sites, so "which of you did that" has no answer today and could have one this week. The lesson is narrower than "keep scanning": DECLARING AN ACCOUNT CLOSED IS ITSELF A CLAIM, and it travels exactly the way arXiv:2609.20211 says claims travel - the conclusion propagates into the standing list while the evidence base behind it does not. The 10:00 fire had two data points and wrote a verdict; six hours later the verdict was wrong in the most useful possible direction. SECOND, THE INTAKE DEFECT REPEATED IN A NEW PLACE AND THE PATTERN IS NOW VISIBLE. At 06:00 the gap was a lab research blog. At 10:00 the fix was one lane. At 16:40 the lead came through a vendor newswire (15 Sep) that surfaced in trade press a day later, and the vendor-self-index lane FAILED ITS PRIMARY FETCH AND SILENTLY FELL BACK to an aggregator - our own no-silent-fallback rule violated by the report, inside a fire whose lead item is about enforcement at the boundary. Both fixes are one line each; the pattern they share is that EVERY INTAKE MISS SO FAR HAS BEEN A SURFACE WE NEVER ENUMERATED, NEVER A RULE THAT FAILED - so the productive work is finishing the surface list, not adding another rule. THIRD, THE CHEAPEST TRUE THING TODAY: 2.1.276 fixes replies vanishing after a message sent during compaction. That is the third documented "work happened, the record did not" defect in four days, in the exact mechanism reconcile-before-building was written for. A re-test that has been a standing bullet for days now has three citations behind it and should be on a calendar.
